title: Seedance 2.5
summary: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 is an AI video generation model featuring one-take creation capabilities and flexible referencing functionality, allowing users to generate complete videos with enhanced control and efficiency.
problem_solved: Streamlines AI-powered video creation by enabling one-shot video generation with flexible content referencing, reducing the complexity of producing high-quality AI-generated videos.
why_valuable: Democratizes professional video content creation by providing more intuitive controls and efficient workflows for AI video generation.
